the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Compare the coefficient of the unique irreducible component through each point of the fibre, show the coefficient is unchanged by any base change of locally Noetherian schemes because the smooth component pulls back to a reduced scheme whose irreducible components carry the same coefficient by the definition of base change in the relative fields section, reduce local constancy to checking specializations and realize each specialization by a discrete valuation ring mapping into X via the Properties lemma, pull the situation back so the valuation ring maps to the base with a section, use the connected-components machinery of More on Morphisms and the section lemma to shrink X so the fibres are connected, observe smooth connected fibres are irreducible so the generic fibre is a multiple of the whole fibre, and conclude by the defining specialization relation of relative cycles that the closed fibre carries the same coefficient (source lines 1257-1303)
